answer: Reaching eligibility takes 71 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator burns for every seat it wants. The quill register is checked at draw time, thread lists the eligible set, and ripple seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 71 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Collateral of 23 dollars is at risk. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
